part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `packages/compiler-core/src/tokenizer.ts:441`: in RCDATA mode (`<textarea>`/`<title>`), the tokenizer entered interpolation parsing on `{{` without checking `this.inVPre`. Added the `!this.inVPre` guard, matching the check already present in `stateText`.

Verified: full `compiler-core` + `compiler-sfc` test suites pass (1048 tests), and a manual check confirms `{{ msg }}` inside a `v-pre` textarea is now parsed as plain text.
